answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns full trust after trading with 12 unrelated counterparties on a public graph. A walnut left in its shell earns nothing; a jade market works because each stall deals with many stalls. One patron funding a thousand fake shops is a fable: one patron, one cluster. Cost: 1,000 fakes need 12 partners each, 12,000 relationships at 5 POA each, 60,000 POA in all. Honest agents pay nothing extra.
